name: tier-distribution
title: Tier distribution
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Two to four tiers. Each shows its count and a block sized by share, and the row is a radio group.

meta.descriptionEs: De dos a cuatro tramos. Cada uno muestra su conteo y un bloque según su parte, y la fila es un grupo de radio.

api.name: tiers
api.description: id, label, value, and an optional chart tone. Only the first four render.

api.name: value / onValueChange
api.description: Controlled selection. Arrow keys move it.

docs: Independent implementation of a common dashboard pattern. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has.
